newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Nippon Life, Principal in Hong Kong alliance.
newsitem.headline: Nippon Life, Principal in Hong Kong alliance.

text.p: Nippon Life Insurance Co, Japan's largest insurer, will second staff to Principal Insurance Co (Hong Kong) Ltd to support marketing efforts, particularly to Japanese clients, Principal said on Thursday.

The move is initially expected to benefit members of the Japanese business community in the territory, which must establish pension schemes under the new Mandatory Provident Fund rules, Principal Insurance said in a statement.

"This arrangement allows Nippon Life to provide employee benefits products of Principal Insurance especially created for the Hong Kong market to its Japanese corporate clients' subsidiaries in Hong Kong," Principal Insurance chief executive Rex Auyeung said.

The move is an extension of a relationship between Principal Financial Group and Nippon Life Insurance Co of America in the United States in which Principal provides administrative support to Nippon Life's pension, group life and medical policyholders, it said.
